Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all Eligible Tenderers as mentioned bellow:
(a)1st Class Enlisted Electrical contractor of RAJUK/ PWD & other Govt. Organization having Experience in similar nature of
works.
(b) The Tenderer must posses:
i) Valid Trade License.
ii) VAT.
iii) Income Tax Clearance Certificate (Up to Date).
iv) Valid ABC Electrical Contractory & Supervisory License.
(c) The Tenderer shall have a minimum 05 (five) years experience in the Similar nature of Electrical works.
(d) The Tenderer shall have successfully completed of Electrical works of minimum amount Tk. 25 (Twenty five) lac single Contract
of 6 Storied Building within last 5 (five) years. i.e years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the news
paper/Website.
(e)Annual Turnover: Last five years (financial year
2012-2013, 2013-2014, 2014-2015, 2015-2016, 2016-2017) average Annual turn over should be required minimum amount Tk. 25
(Twenty five) lac.
(f)Liquid Asset: Should be required minimum amount Tk. 25 (Twenty five) lac.
Furnishing of any false, forged and misleading documents by tenderer shall result in rejection of his/her tender may lead to forfeit
of tender security and Legal action may be taken against Tenderer per PPR & PPA.
